authority.note: This packet frames required adversarial reviews; script generation never answers or decides them.

limitations: Evidence context is assembled mechanically and may include irrelevant rows; the reviewer must judge relevance.
A pending red-team prompt is not a judgment_review and cannot support an M6 decision.
No script-authored verdict or recommendation is permitted.
Priority weights allocate review attention only.
Later judgment must preserve Commander-first identity and bracket-specific context.

reviews.adversarial_challenge: Assume multiple permanent types are answered over several turns. Identify which strategic routes actually rebuild and which collapse after repeated removal.

value: Generic Grixis Thoracle/Consultation conversion rejected (decisions L17).
Keep cards that use flash or firebending mana over generic value.

blueprint_failure_modes.description: Artifact wipes and stax hit both mana and combos.
Without Mai and Zuko the deck loses flash speed, not its wins.

value.interaction: Force of Will, Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Swan Song, Toxic Deluge, Cyclonic Rift, flash artifacts.
value.mana: 31 lands plus heavy artifact fast mana.
value.protection: Lightning Greaves, Deflecting Swat, instant-speed deployment.

accepted_role.advances_plan: Flash for Allies and artifacts lets the combo and value pieces land on opponents' turns, and firebending adds combat mana.
accepted_role.honest_note: Every Spellbook infinite in the list (Monolith + Rings, the Top loops, Breach) works without Mai and Zuko; the commander adds speed and instant-speed safety, not the kill.
